description.zh: 需要查询的策略类型（默认查询自定义和系统预定义策略）。
description.en: The types of policies to be queried (default queries both custom and system predefined policies).

description.zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。起始值为**1**。默认值为**1**，表示从第**1**页开始显示。
description.en: Specifies the page number from which to start displaying the query results. The starting value is **1**. The default value is **1**, indicating that the display starts from the **1st** page.

description.zh:
关联的上级策略ID。
      
（具体的依赖关系从低到高依次为章节->条例->标准）
description.en:
ID of the associated parent policy.

(The specific dependency relationship from low to high is: Section -> Requirement -> Standard)

description.zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
Language type for request and response messages, with a default value of **zh**. Possible values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的检查项信息的数量。默认值为**50**，表示每页显示50条检查项信息。
description.en: Number of check item information entries displayed per page during pagination. The default value is **50**, indicating 50 entries per page.
ID of the newly added classification setting.
Name of the newly added classification setting.

description.zh:
自定义检查项规则的策略类型：
- **STANDARD**：新增归属标准
- **REQUIREMENT**：新增归属条例
- **SECTION**：新增归属章节
description.en:
Policy type of the custom check item rule:
- **STANDARD**: New standard
- **REQUIREMENT**: New requirement
- **SECTION**: New section

description.zh:
关联的策略大类的名称（PolicyType取值为STANDARD时为必填）：
- **AISPM**：AI配置管理（AI-SPM）
- **IDENTITY_PERMISSION**：身份权限管理(CIEM)
- **RISK**：安全风险
- **COMPLIANCE**：合规风险
description.en:
Name of the associated major policy category (required when PolicyType is STANDARD):
- **AISPM**: AI Configuration Management (AI-SPM)
- **IDENTITY_PERMISSION**: Identity and Permission Management (CIEM)
- **RISK**: Security Risk
- **COMPLIANCE**: Compliance Risk

title.zh: 查询自定义检查项归属策略分类
title.en: Query Custom Check Item Policy Classification

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas list-check-policies --policy-type STANDARD --policy-id 1000000000001 --policy-show-name testPolicyName --dependent-policy-id 1000000000002 --check-types CUSTOM --type AISPM --page-size 20 --current-page 1 --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ListCheckPolicies --region cn-hangzhou --CheckTypes.1 CUSTOM --PolicyType STANDARD --Type AISPM --PageSize 20 --CurrentPage 1 --DependentPolicyId 1000000000002 --PolicyShowName testPolicyName --Lang zh --PolicyId 1000000000001
